verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents a first-party hosted MCP server that lets an assistant such as Claude "create, configure, and manage the agents in your workspace through natural language," plus an official agents skill for AI coding assistants. Together these give users a vendor-provided way to operate the product with natural-language commands. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface (operation depends on an external MCP client such as Claude), documentation of which operations are covered via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: an assistant such as Claude can create, configure, and manage the agents in your workspace through natural language, with nothing to install or run locally
connect the hosted MCP server to Claude or any other MCP client to create and manage agents through natural language
Use the ElevenLabs agents skill to build and manage voice agents from your AI coding assistant
